oracle.statement: every mixed batch that contains one invalid action (create_alias -> nonexistent collection, documented 404 by qdrant_behavioral_aliases_update_001) is rejected with status>=400 (a 200 => Type1_IllegalSuccess), and after each rejection the prefix-scoped alias map is exactly the pre-batch map: the valid co-actions (AY/AZ2/AY2) must NOT exist, and in the destructive case the delete of the live alias AX inside the failed batch must NOT be applied (AX -> C1 still present) => partial application is Type4_StateLogicViolation
